The '''Battle of Daalang''' was a battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the battle on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daalang/Legends|Daalang]], the [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]] of [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]] penetrated the energy shield that protected the Separatists' [[Anti-orbital cannon|antiorbital]] [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass-driver cannon]], using their walkers' speed to rush past the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] defenses and destroy the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. Their actions allowed the Republic's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Eliminator (Clone Wars)|''Eliminator'']] to unleash an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]], and Lightning Squadron were able to escape the area before the bombardment thanks to their AT-RTs.<ref name="Galaxy" />
